attributes.board_name: New Jersey Occupational Therapy Advisory Council (Division of Consumer Affairs)

rules.notes: No continuing education is listed as a renewal condition: the Council's licensee orientation describes renewal (licenses expire every two years on September 30 of odd-numbered years; renewal up to 30 days late with a $100 late fee, then automatic suspension; inactive renewal possible) without any CE requirement, and the Occupational Therapy Licensing Act has no CE section (unlike the physical therapy act, N.J.S.A. 45:9-37.34f).
